# Repository settings

- **Description:** Vendor-neutral field notes for bounded, observable, testable,
  production-ready AI agent systems.
- **Topics:** `ai-agents`, `system-design`, `agentic-ai`, `architecture`, `llm`,
  `ai-safety`, `prompt-injection`, `observability`, `evaluation`, `human-in-the-loop`
- **Features:** Enable Issues, Discussions, private vulnerability reporting, Dependabot,
  secret scanning, and push protection.
- **Branches:** Protect `main`; require Documentation CI, one approving review, and
  resolved conversations.
- **Social preview:** Use a 1280×640 rendering of the reference architecture with the
  title “Agentic System Design Notes”.
